verdict.rationale:
The SDK offers 'structured outputs' where you define a schema and get back validated JSON matching it, which is the closest evidence to schema validation, but this is runtime validation of agent output, not compile/build-time type checking of the agent's own reasoning or code as the story implies. There's no evidence of static type-checking integration, IDE-time error catching, or build-time validation gates for agent actions.

missing for 10: explicit build-time/compile-time type-checking tooling, evidence of the agent catching its own mistakes before execution (not just output shape), IDE/linter integration for agent-authored code.
